acceptanceCriteria: Merging a batch with an unsealed tracked change.cem.json is prevented or auto-sealed, with a regression test.
body:
Source: wave-6 lane report (2026-10-11).

Observed: the w4 batch merge (#789) left an unsealed .corvint/change.cem.json tracked on main, so every later dogfood-seal refused with unarchived-base-cem.

Expected: the batch flow seals or archives the CEM before merging, or a check fails fast before the merge.

Acceptance: merging a batch with an unsealed tracked change.cem.json is prevented or auto-sealed, with a regression test.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#801 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801; landed by batch PR #801); on main at 8f032d969f26dc0d3bd10ec0248566070161272d (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/801). Tests named in the PR: DCW-V0-043 dogfood tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: Merge to main left unsealed .corvint/change.cem.json tracked; later dogfood-seal refuses unarchived-base-cem
